title: Objective Management V1
goal: Create a durable objective and activity management section in the MIM UI/backend so Dave, MIM, TOD, and Codex can add, plan, prioritize, execute, track, and report objectives from one queue.
required_capabilities: objectives page or section in the MIM UI/backend
add objective from conversation with Dave or MIM
add objective from Codex handoff into the same list
show objective status and completion reports
show supporting objectives, planning, and evidence
show MIM/TOD-created objectives and working/completion state
allow collaborative pre-implementation planning before objective execution
report completed objectives directly to Dave when Dave is present
implementation_principles: reuse the existing objective/task API and shared ledgers before adding new stores
do not create a parallel source of truth
do not count queue activity alone as completion
blocked objectives must publish explicit blocker evidence
planning and supporting objectives must be linked to parent objectives
conversation-created objectives should support a draft/planning state before execution

task_deck.title: Inventory existing objective/task APIs and UI routes
Design Objective Management V1 data contract
Add MIM UI Objectives page or section
Add objective creation from UI conversation and Codex handoff
Bind MIM/TOD pending objective worker behavior
Add completion reports and Dave-present notification
Add objective backlog hygiene and learning conversion

suggested_additions: objective inbox with draft, ready, active, blocked, complete, archived lanes
parent/child objective graph for supporting objectives
objective source tags: Dave, MIM, TOD, Codex, system, failure-learning
recency and priority score so urgent lab blockers surface above background training
decision log per objective showing why MIM/TOD chose the current next step
operator presence notification queue so completed objectives are reported when Dave is available
objective templates for hardware, voice, UI/backend, research, training, and repair work
success_criteria: MIM UI/backend exposes an Objectives page or section
objectives can be added from UI and conversation
Codex-created objectives are inserted into the same objective list
pending, active, completed, and blocked status is visible
supporting objectives and planning are visible
MIM/TOD-created objectives show creator/source and working/completion status
MIM reports completed objectives to Dave when Dave is present
implementation is verified with tests, screenshots, API responses, or explicit blocked evidence
next_action: MIM/TOD should begin with TSK-1935, inventory existing objective/task APIs and UI routes, then publish an implementation plan before editing.
